options.reason: The table was assembled to predict HER2 status, which exists as the sole binary outcome label (15 positive, 107 negative). All remaining columns are protein abundance measurements of one kind and are candidate features, not outcomes; several are entirely missing or near-unique and should be filtered on training folds only. Hence binary classification with class imbalance, evaluated by stratified repeated cross-validation with PR-AUC, calibration and decision-curve analysis; sample_id is a row key and never a feature.
options.title: binary
